title: China National Film Museum
scope: Standing 2007 China National Film Museum in Beijing, including the notched glass northwest entry, folded charcoal cladding and the adjacent clapperboard forecourt walls.
limitations: The standing building is located with its named mapped outline. Façade height, folds and portal setback are estimates. Secondary elevations and roof equipment are generalized.
Ten separate elements follow their mapped outlines in the forecourt. Their cap profiles and the screen location and proportions are approximate.
The public entry, screen and apron are exterior features. Internal museum displays and cinema fit-outs are outside scope.
